decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap variant of existing drains and the design trend still offers upside, so keeping the option open costs little while demand settles, though its website visibility stays modest.
The channel for seamless coverings sits at the core of the barrier-free bathroom strategy, has its own page and is cheap to hold, so its value looks increasingly likely to be realized.

Product F, the newer pump-drain shower channel with its own page, partly overlaps the pump-assisted line, so the older line's option value falls, but two years is still short for renovation demand and holding it costs moderately little.
The newly launched pump-drain channel is prominently presented and its uncertainty is still unresolved, so the firm keeps the option open to learn about its renovation-market value.
